title: The Machine With Many Faces: Post-Exploitation Identity Misuse in SPIFFE/SPIRE
content_md: Learn how root access on a compromised K8s node allows attackers to utilize SPIFFE/SPIRE metadata to spoof and harvest co-located workload identities. The post The Machine With Many Faces: Post-Exploitation Identity Misuse in SPIFFE/SPIRE appeared first on Unit 42 .
